newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch trade mission to visit Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Dutch trade mission to visit Tunisia.

text.p: A trade mission headed by Dutch Junior Economics Minister Anneke van Dok will visit Tunisia from March 17 to 20, her ministry said on Wednesday.
"The visit aims to promote mutual trade and investments and to intensify bilateral economic links," the ministry said in a statement.
Van Dok, who will be accompanied by representatives of five unidentified Dutch companies, will meet the Tunisian ministers of Trade, International Cooperation, Foreign Affairs, Housing and Tourism.
In 1995, the European Union reached a Euro-Mediterranean agreement with Tunisia which should gradually liberalise the flows of goods, services and capital.
The Netherlands is expected to ratify this agreement before the end of this year, probably as the last EU member state, the Economics Ministry said.
